policies.dispatch: Only READY/PARTIAL tasks with all depends_on DONE_PUBLISHED and no lease are candidates; BLOCKED never dispatched.
policies.claim: Fresh canonical plan; one READY/PARTIAL task or compatible package represented by one task; dependencies DONE_PUBLISHED. CAS IN_PROGRESS with owner/UTC lease/run and mandatory readback before implementation. Package may combine components; native operations retain exact target/journal gates. No new schedulers.
policies.completion: On actual completion, verify artifacts, CI/receipt and acceptance; CAS-write DONE_PUBLISHED with evidence and clear owner/lease/claim_ref. For incomplete results write PARTIAL with evidence; for failed work BLOCKED with blocked_reason. Never claim DONE from chat text or a publisher receipt alone.
policies.deduplication: One semantic work_key per task, explicit topic_id through topics[].task_ids; duplicate work keys rejected; related tasks share sources but different scopes. Historical 72-branch semantic dedup remains open.
policies.mutation: Canonical research branch for plan/evidence. Development uses new isolated feature branches/PRs from verified existing code; no main/master/protected/tested-branch changes or merges without authorization. User grants PLN writes in current chat; bind this scenario to APA_Isolated_Writer_Test_01.pln and freshly verify identity. APX mutation still requires separate authorization. Current directly authorized renamed isolated copy may be bound only with exact locally recorded identity/saved-file hash and independently verified accepted native baseline; existing default project/CLI restrictions remain. Full private paths and raw PLN/IFC/dumps stay local. Four original accepted building Wall/Roof junctions are read-only in the current109GUID baseline; specific changes require an explicitly authorized separate saved copy and exact operation/plan binding. Partial lower-face cap coverage must not be promoted to complete geometric repair.
policies.research: Normal ChatGPT with GitHub connector; Deep Research and paid tools require explicit authorization.
policies.evidence: REPORTED != SOURCE_VERIFIED != BUILD_PASS != LIVE_PASS. Synthetic publisher success proves no Archicad runtime behavior.
policies.trigger: Current user-authorized persistent Work chat may execute sequential development; existing user-configured Scheduled tasks remain separate triggers. No new scheduler/controller-created runs. No promised execution outside the active session.
policies.research_pipeline: Same PROJECT_PLAN.json registry for research and development. research_routes links each P70 S-ID to source artifacts already in task.inputs and to reusable research S-IDs; read branch/file URLs from artifact.uri, verify current source SHA before use. Research may run ahead for later P70 actions while present action BUILD/INTEGRATION proceeds. SUFFICIENT must be independently reviewed with evidence before deferring its research; NOT_ASSESSED is never automatic PASS. Do not repeat completed research without changed source or uncovered applicability gap.
policies.integration_priority: MASTER v3.1: INTEGRATE ALL → CONNECT TOGETHER → SYSTEM TEST → GAP-DRIVEN FIX → OPTIMIZE → PACKAGE. Compatible donor adapters may be developed in one claimed package. Preserve accepted core and mandatory engineering/native acceptance. Independent source/offline preparation is not blocked by later operational gates. One canonical plan and one SceneWriter.
policies.native_tool_priority: MORPH LAST RESORT — permanent mandatory rule for all subsequent APA creation/editing. Choose Archicad native parametric Wall/Slab/Beam/Column/Roof/Shell/Stair/Railing/Opening/MEP or another suitable tool by construction purpose. Inspect available native tools and API first; a missing APA adapter is not a reason to use Morph. Morph only when checked native tools cannot faithfully realize the geometry, the API/geometry rejection is documented, and mandatory BIM properties/relationships are preserved. Battens25x150mm and counterbattens50x50mm prioritize true native Beam. Morph classified Beam/IfcBeam is not an Archicad Beam. Retain accepted existing Morphs without repeating their creation.
